concerns.text: Plan element 'Phase 1 Synthetic Data Generation' (generate_synthetic_data.py, mapped to FR-001/FR-002) has NO corresponding task — tasks.md deliberately deleted it in favor of pyspedas real-data ingestion, but plan.md was never updated. An implementer following the plan's phase table cannot satisfy it; either the plan must be revised to match tasks.md or a task must reconcile the plan. The plan's 'covers every FR & SC' phase table is now invalid.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T003 vs spec.md:FR-001 and constitution.md:Principle VI
concerns.text: FR-001 requires composition data 'from ACE/WIND archives' and the constitution (Principle VI, NON-NEGOTIABLE) requires raw files from 'the ACE SWICS instrument AND the WIND composition dataset' stored unchanged. T003 fetches only ACE SWICS composition plus OMNI bulk/indices — no task ingests or preserves the WIND composition dataset. Missing task for a required source.

Coverage table cites 'pytest tests/unit/test_sensitivity.py' and 'tests/unit/test_significance.py' as demonstrating commands, but no task lists these test files as deliverables (T010/T011 name only artifact files and inline verification). Either add the test files to T010/T011 deliverables or fix the table to match the actual verification commands.

T012 requires a provenance block 'per the data model', but data-model.md still documents provenance sourced from synthetic_config.yaml and a synthetic ingestion flow (generate_synthetic_data.py). The plan/data-model element the task points to no longer matches any task's pipeline; the data-model update is not covered by any task.
